text:
Priya Patel: Need a quick copy pass for the modal we show when someone temporarily suspends a Dedicated GPU pool for maintenance. Users keep interpreting it as deletion. Screenshot: https://redwood.screenshot/suspend-pool.png
Diego: Saw a few support tickets too. Current headline: "Stop pool?" Body: "Stopping this pool will remove running jobs." Super scary.
Maya: We should emphasize the temporary nature and that workloads can be resumed or migrated. Tone: calm, instructive. Keep headline short.
Priya Patel: Constraints: modal is small, two buttons (primary destructive-looking), and we already have a migration checklist flow. Primary action triggers a suspend API that preserves metadata.
Alex (eng): Implementation note: suspend is reversible and we keep the pool config for 30 days. We can show an optional small line with that retention. Also include a checkbox opt-in to migrate queued jobs (if available) rather than dropping them.
Sam (DesignBot): Microcopy rules reminder: avoid words like "delete" or "remove" unless irreversible. Lead with the outcome + next step. Primary action label should be verb-first and descriptive (<= 3 words).
Priya Patel: Draft candidates:
Headline options:
- "Temporarily stop this pool"
- "Pause pool for maintenance"
- "Suspend pool (reversible)"
Body candidates (short):
- "Pauses GPU capacity. Running jobs will be stopped; you can resume the pool later."
- "This will temporarily pause the pool. Pool configuration is retained for 30 days."
Action label ideas:
- Primary: "Pause pool" / "Suspend pool" / "Stop for maintenance"
- Secondary: "Cancel" / "View migration options" (secondary opens checklist)
Maya: Prefer "Pause pool" as primary. Short, less scary. Body should call out "paused, not deleted" and where to find more info (link to migration checklist). Keep the retention line optional (show only when we know 30 days is accurate).
Diego: Wording suggestion that fits mobile:
```
Headline: "Pause pool for maintenance"
Body: "Pool will be paused (not deleted). Running jobs will stop; you can resume later."
Primary: "Pause pool"
Secondary: "Migration options"
```
Alex (eng): I'll wire the migration options link and ensure the API returns a retention window field so UI can show "config retained for 30 days" if present. Also will add aria-describedby linking to the checklist.
Sam (DesignBot): Localization note: avoid parentheses in code strings; use separate fields for retention text. For screen readers, make the primary action read as a clear command: "Pause pool, button".
Priya Patel: Final text for mock handoff (code-safe):
```
Headline: "Pause pool for maintenance"
Body: "Pool will be paused — not deleted. Running jobs will stop; you can resume the pool later."
Retention (optional): "Pool configuration retained for 30 days"
Primary action: "Pause pool"
Secondary action: "View migration options"
Confirmation toast: "Pool paused. You can resume or migrate jobs from the pool settings." 
```
Maya: LGTM. Tiny nit: test hyphen vs em dash for wrap on smaller widths. If space is super tight, fallback headline: "Pause pool".
Diego: Thanks — I'll update the support doc to clarify user expectations and link it from the migration options.
Alex (eng): I'll implement aria labels and the retention flag tomorrow, will ping if we need shorter copies.
Priya Patel: Great, I'll update the Figma and push the new strings to the i18n queue. Thanks all :sparkles:
